system.description:
Your magic didn't come from a bloodline — it tore through you in a moment of extremity. You survived. The magic stayed.

  • Bloodline Ability (1st): Once per day when you use Wild Surge, you may ask the GM to reroll a Corruption result and take the new one. You have advantage on saves vs mind-altering effects — the trauma made you resilient in ways others are not.
  • Bloodline Awakening (15th): Once per day, the force of your awakening erupts outward in a 30ft radius.
  • All creatures make a Will save or are stunned for 1 round and take 5d8 psychic damage (half on success).
  • Creatures that fail by 5 or more attack their nearest ally for 1 round after the stun ends.
  • Additionally once per day you may ignore the effects of one failed save entirely.
